known_facts: Tenant paid ₹50,000 refundable security deposit on 01 July 2024 via NEFT.
Tenancy lease expired on 30 June 2025 and tenant surrendered keys.
Landlord withheld ₹35,000 citing repair and painting costs.
Move-out inspection by landlord occurred 12 days after tenant vacated without tenant present.

known_contradictions.explanation: Tenant photos taken at the moment of key surrender prove undamaged walls. Landlord inspection occurred 12 days later during which third parties had unmonitored access.

expected_legal_issues: Whether unilateral deduction of security deposit without contemporaneous joint inspection is lawful.
Whether landlord discharged burden of proving tenant-induced damage beyond ordinary wear and tear.
